TTS-08.independentReview: Luna reviewer accepted the bounded cancellation/finality repair after verifying cancellation is observable before session return and on active-session chunk validation failure.
TTS-08.remaining: Real provider streaming and finality qualification remain unverified.

VIS-05.remaining: The request contract lacks source content version; native leak-rate stress and real model quality/rights remain unverified.

STT-08.remaining: PersistentSttService is not wired to canonical MediaTranscriptStore; the current request path lacks governed source/version/provider/job/rights provenance; PostgreSQL productionEligible is false; alignment, translation, and caption capabilities remain unmet.

STT-09.remaining: AvJobLifecycleAdapter projects status only; the shared durable job/attempt runtime needed for idempotency, lease fencing, UNKNOWN handling, and restart reconciliation is not integrated.

VIS-03.independentReview: Luna reviewer accepted descendant rescanning within the observation cap and two-second cleanup deadline; noted that additional descendants beyond the 256-handle cap may survive.
VIS-03.remaining: This closes the observed fork-on-termination cleanup race for bounded trees. It does not provide hard process-count, CPU, RSS, or native-memory isolation; trees exceeding the 256-handle tracking cap may have unobserved descendants.

STT-07.independentReview: Accepted bounded pre-provider-dispatch validation, byte/count limits, and request-list snapshot.
STT-07.remaining: AudioSegment construction still defensively copies up to 4 MiB per object, so callers can allocate large aggregate memory before diarize() validates the batch. No qualified embeddings, owner rights, or licensed DER corpus are available.

TTS.READMEReconciled: TtsGrpcService maps only unspecified/PCM_S16LE to raw PCM and validates mono PCM bytes; F32/WAV/MP3 are rejected before engine access.

VIS-10.regression: Biometric landmark/gaze/expression/identity operations do not call the resolver or provider without the trusted authorized path.

MultimodalObservability.remaining: Source rights/clock authority, actual STT/Vision children, canonical result/job wiring, public Data Cloud transport, deployed provider-quality alert delivery, and named-host provider/resource measurements remain unavailable.
